headline: Financial Trio Earns NT$904.2 Billion in First Half; Full-Year Profits Expected to Set New Record - Liberty Finance
summary: Taiwan's 'financial trio' recorded combined pre-tax earnings of NT$904.245 billion in the first six months, up 139.14% year on year. The figure is a record for the same period.
why: Taiwan's largest financial holding groups span banking, insurance and securities, and their earnings are a bellwether for the island's financial sector.
